scenario_name: Toyota Connected Europe - Project Portfolio & Mieruka Replacement
scenario_description: Enterprise project governance, resource management, timesheet management, and financial forecasting for TCEU's digital consulting practice. Covers the full lifecycle from lead capture through project closure, plus ongoing resource and licence management. Replaces the legacy Mieruka system.

perspectives.name: Operational
perspectives.primary_concern: Are we delivering sprint commitments? Are blockers cleared? Is the backlog healthy?

perspectives.name: Management
perspectives.purpose: Ensure project health and resource optimization
perspectives.primary_concern: Are projects on track? Do we have the right people? What are the risks?

perspectives.name: Financial
perspectives.purpose: Optimize portfolio investment and ensure financial accountability
perspectives.primary_concern: Are we investing in the right projects? What's our forecast accuracy? Are we profitable?

systems.name: Mieruka (Power Apps / Dataverse)
systems.notes: Custom project governance platform built on Power Apps and Dataverse. 6 canvas apps, 58 custom tables, 41 Power Automate workflows. Covers project setup, resource allocation (TC_FTEValues), budget management (TC_ProjectBudget), timesheet approval (TC_TimeSheet), and HR processes. Has hit architectural ceiling: 40% data revert rate, timesheet approval triggers on every row modification with sequential lookups, chained SharePoint security flows cause severe performance issues. Being rebuilt.

systems.name: Jira
systems.notes: Sales pipeline system. Defined handoff point from Jira pipeline into Mieruka project creation. Not used for sprint/delivery tracking at TCEU — Mieruka handles project delivery. Integration planned via Microsoft Fabric.

systems.name: Excel Spreadsheets
systems.notes: Heavy offline usage for budget estimation (sits between Jira sales pipeline and Mieruka, causing budget divergence), resource allocation (Mieruka limitation: one person per project), forecasting, and status reports. The de facto source of truth for many processes due to Mieruka performance issues.

systems.name: SharePoint
systems.notes: Project document management with per-record security. Six dedicated Power Automate flows manage folder creation and permissions (Break Inheritance, Grant Permission, Revoke Permission x2, Create Project Folder, Validate Attachments). Described as the most fragile part of the current solution.

systems.name: Oracle (Finance / GL)
systems.notes: Finance system of record. Revenue recognition data posted from Mieruka. Required for P&L analysis, cost tracking, and actuals comparison. Integration planned for Option C via Microsoft Fabric.

systems.name: HiBob
systems.notes: HR system from which team and manager data is synchronised to Mieruka. Used for organisational structure and people data. No direct API integration today — manual sync creates data quality issues.

systems.name: Microsoft Teams
systems.notes: Team membership lookup used in timesheet approval flow routing via Get Team ID workflow. Limited integration scope. Also used for Office 365/Exchange email delivery of all approval notifications and daily digest emails.

systems.name: Power BI (Dataverse)
systems.notes: Two Power BI reports referenced in Mieruka: compliance report and general management report. Read-only consumption from Dataverse. Not a data source — Mieruka feeds Power BI.

systems.name: Microsoft Fabric
systems.notes: Proposed unified analytical layer (Option C architecture). Would consolidate data from Mieruka/Dataverse, Jira, Oracle, and HiBob. Integration work with Oracle and Jira not included in initial build cost. Enables continuous revenue reconciliation and forecasting.

entities.name: Project
entities.description: Demand-side entity representing a customer or internal engagement. Linked to Programme where applicable. Manages project setup, budget, resources, timesheets, approvals, and financial tracking. Sourced from TC_Projects table. Current issue: project codes created without formal initiation gate or in-system Finance review.

lenses.interpretation: A backlog of work to execute in sprints
A delivery commitment with RAG status and resource needs
A cost centre and revenue stream

entities.name: Programme
entities.description: Groups related projects under a Programme Owner. Enables consolidated budget and resource view across project group. New entity added as baseline requirement for rebuild — no Programme Owner role existed in current system.

lenses.interpretation: Portfolio of projects to coordinate and prioritise
Investment bucket with aggregate financials

entities.name: Resource (FTE)
entities.description: Individual resource record capturing role, skill level, location, team, FTE type, start/end dates, and rate information. Links a Person to their commercial and capacity planning attributes. Sourced from TC_FTE table. Contractor rates stored here but must be secured (GDPR and commercial sensitivity risk identified).

core_attributes.name: Charge-Out Rate
core_attributes.description: Billing rate (security gap: visible to standard users)

lenses.interpretation: A team member executing sprint work
A capacity unit to allocate across projects
A cost line with a blended rate

entities.name: Account
entities.description: A client or internal account that owns projects

lenses.interpretation: A client relationship to manage
A revenue source with contract terms

entities.name: Timesheet
entities.description: Weekly timesheet entry capturing hours worked by a person on a project for a specific date. Supports billable and non-billable time codes. Subject to Team Manager approval (currently Finance blanket-approves without validation). Feeds invoice generation and revenue recognition. Sourced from TC_TimeSheet table.

lenses.interpretation: Daily time recording to submit
Approved time for project tracking
Billable hours driving revenue recognition

entities.name: Project Budget
entities.description: Budget version entity capturing approved or planned budget for a project. Supports multiple versions per project with Latest Plan flag. Tracks revenue, costs (COGS and IDOD), approval status and audit trail. Sourced from TC_ProjectBudget table. Subject to threshold-based approval routing rules (TC_ProjectApprovalRules).

lenses.interpretation: Spending ceiling to manage against
Financial commitment requiring variance analysis

entities.name: Statement of Work
entities.description: Contractual document defining project scope, deliverables, and terms

lenses.interpretation: Scope boundary for project delivery
Revenue commitment and billing basis

entities.name: Lead
entities.description: A potential project opportunity in the presales pipeline

lenses.interpretation: Pipeline opportunity to qualify and staff
Potential revenue to forecast

entities.name: Person
entities.description: Individual identity record in the HR system. Separate from their Resource (FTE) record. Contains personal data and is linked to team and organisational hierarchy via HiBob sync.

lenses.interpretation: A team member with identity and organisational context

entities.name: Team
entities.description: Organisational unit grouping people under a Team Manager. Part of the formal operating model. Team Manager owns supply-side headcount and approves timesheets for their team.

lenses.interpretation: A group of resources executing work together
A capacity unit for supply-side planning

entities.name: Discipline
entities.description: Functional discipline (e.g., Backend Development, QA, DevOps) that groups teams. Resource Manager owns discipline-level capacity planning and TBA/TBR lifecycle.

lenses.interpretation: Functional capability area to plan and forecast

entities.name: TBA (To Be Allocated)
entities.description: Formal unnamed demand line representing a resource requirement before assignment to a named individual. Contains role, skill level, location, and project link. Can be escalated to a TBR (To Be Recruited). Sourced from TC_TBA table.

lenses.interpretation: An unfilled resource slot on a project
A demand signal requiring capacity matching

entities.name: TBR (To Be Recruited)
entities.description: Formal recruitment trigger escalated from a TBA demand line. Owned by Resource Manager with audit trail. Initiates recruitment request workflow. Sourced from TC_TBR table.

lenses.interpretation: An active recruitment requisition to fill
A committed hiring action with budget impact

entities.name: FTE Allocation (Monthly Resource Line)
entities.description: Monthly resource allocation record linking a resource (FTE) to a project budget for a specific month. Tracks allocation quantity (days), role, skill level, charge-out and cost values. Flags TBA/TBR status. Sourced from TC_FTEValues table.

lenses.interpretation: A resource commitment for a specific month
A costed resource line driving P&L

entities.name: Revenue Schedule
entities.description: Monthly revenue values by project, service category, and task category. Supports multiple revenue types (T&M, milestone, fixed capacity). Multi-currency with FX rate application. Sourced from TC_RevenueValues table.

lenses.interpretation: A revenue commitment by billing model

entities.name: Approval Rule
entities.description: Threshold-based rule configuration for project budget approval routing. Defines cost, GM, and revenue thresholds with configurable product type and department. Currently broken; requires rebuild. Sourced from TC_ProjectApprovalRules table.

lenses.interpretation: A governance gate controlling budget approval
A financial control threshold

attributes.name: Project Code
attributes.description: Oracle-assigned project code. Single source of truth for project identity across systems.
attributes.notes: Created in Oracle when project is approved. Used as join key across Mieruka, Jira, and timesheets.

attributes.name: Project Stage
attributes.description: Current stage gate (e.g. Discovery, Build, UAT, Live). Manually updated in Mieruka.
attributes.notes: Current issue: projects created without formal initiation gate. No blocking transition to Active until Finance approves project code.

attributes.name: RAG Status
attributes.description: Red/Amber/Green health indicator. Manually set by PM based on subjective assessment.
attributes.notes: Subjective. Different PMs have different thresholds. No automated triggers.

attributes.name: Budget Approved
attributes.description: Approved budget amount for a project. Set during project initiation.
attributes.notes: Subject to threshold-based approval routing rules (TC_ProjectApprovalRules). Budget versioning with Latest Plan flag. Multiple versions per project supported.

attributes.name: Budget Breakdown
attributes.description: Detailed budget lines by category (people, tools, infrastructure). Maintained in Mieruka.
attributes.notes: Often out of date. Detailed breakdowns sometimes only exist in PM's Excel.

attributes.name: Actuals (Spend)
attributes.description: Actual spend posted against project code. Source of truth from Oracle GL.
attributes.notes: Reliable but only updated after month-end close. 2-3 week lag for current period.

attributes.name: Terms of Reference
attributes.description: Project charter / terms of reference document link.
attributes.notes: Link stored in Mieruka, actual document in SharePoint.

attributes.name: Statement of Work Document
attributes.description: Signed SOW document stored in SharePoint.
attributes.notes: Once signed, immutable. Metadata linking to project not always set.

attributes.name: Architecture Documentation
attributes.description: Technical architecture documents stored in SharePoint.
attributes.notes: Quality varies. Not all projects have formal architecture docs.

attributes.name: Presales Estimate
attributes.description: Initial effort and cost estimate created during presales phase.
attributes.notes: Produced in Excel during proposal phase. Often used as baseline even when scope changes.

attributes.name: Demand by Role
attributes.description: Required resource roles and quantities for a lead/project.
attributes.notes: Tracked in Excel. No automated link to actual resource availability.

attributes.name: Gross Margin Estimate
attributes.description: Estimated gross margin for the opportunity.
attributes.notes: Based on presales estimate and assumed rates. Often optimistic.

attributes.name: Completed Tasks / Stories
attributes.description: Count and details of completed Jira stories in current/recent sprints.
attributes.notes: Good quality data when teams follow Jira workflow. Some teams less disciplined.

attributes.name: Story Points Completed
attributes.description: Story points completed per sprint. Used for velocity tracking.
attributes.notes: Depends on consistent estimation across teams. Not all teams use story points.

attributes.name: Planned Story Points
attributes.description: Story points planned for current sprint.
attributes.notes: Set at sprint planning. Good indicator of capacity commitment.

attributes.name: Backlog Size
attributes.description: Total story points in the product backlog.
attributes.notes: Only meaningful if backlog is groomed. Stale backlogs give misleading numbers.

attributes.name: Blended Day Rate
attributes.description: Resource cost rate calculated from role and skill level rate card (TC_FTERates, TC_FTESkillLevelRate). Security gap: contractor rates visible to standard users.
attributes.notes: Updated annually. May not reflect actual cost for contractors.

attributes.name: People Cost
attributes.description: Total people cost for a resource including salary, NI, benefits.
attributes.notes: Synchronized from HR. Updated when salary changes.

attributes.name: Contracts
attributes.description: Contractor/employment contracts stored in SharePoint.
attributes.notes: Immutable once signed. Metadata linking to resource not always set.

attributes.name: Resource Level / Grade
attributes.description: Seniority level of a resource (Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead, etc.).
attributes.notes: Updated during promotions/reviews.

attributes.name: Resource Availability
attributes.description: Available capacity (days/hours) for a resource in a given period.
attributes.notes: Should account for holidays but HiBob integration is manual.

attributes.name: Resource Allocation
attributes.description: Monthly FTE allocation record from TC_FTEValues. Links resource to project for a specific month with allocation days, role, skill level, and rates. No capacity ceiling enforcement.
attributes.notes: Stored in TC_FTEValues. No aggregation layer exists. No team hierarchy enforces supply-side capacity limits.

attributes.name: Resource Allocation (Excel Override)
attributes.description: Detailed resource allocation across multiple projects maintained in Excel due to Mieruka limitations.
attributes.notes: The real source of truth for multi-project allocation. Mieruka data is often wrong.

attributes.name: FTE Allocation (Granular)
attributes.description: Granular FTE allocation (e.g. 0.5 FTE). Currently only possible in Excel.
attributes.notes: Mieruka cannot do partial allocation. Excel is the only place this data exists.

attributes.name: Account Status
attributes.description: Current status of the client account (Active, Dormant, Closed).

attributes.name: Account Type
attributes.description: Type classification (Client, Internal, Partner).

attributes.name: Account Start Date
attributes.description: Date the account relationship began.

attributes.name: Account End Date
attributes.description: Date the account relationship ended (if applicable).

attributes.name: Hours Submitted
attributes.description: Timesheet hours submitted by the resource for a period.
attributes.notes: Self-reported. Quality depends on whether resources submit daily or batch at end of week.

attributes.name: Hours Approved
attributes.description: Timesheet hours approved by the PM.
attributes.notes: Currently Finance blanket-approves without validation. Rebuild changes approver to Team Manager. Only approved timesheets feed invoice and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: Approved Days
attributes.description: Total approved working days for the period.
attributes.notes: Derived from approved hours. Used for financial reporting.

attributes.name: Time Off / Leave
attributes.description: Approved leave and time-off from HiBob.
attributes.notes: Reliable source but not automatically reflected in Mieruka availability.

attributes.name: Timesheet Granularity (Jira)
attributes.description: Time logged against individual Jira stories/tasks.
attributes.notes: More granular than Mieruka timesheets. Not all teams use Jira time logging.

attributes.name: Revenue (Actuals)
attributes.description: Recognized revenue from Oracle GL.
attributes.notes: System of record. Updated after month-end. Basis for all financial reporting.

attributes.name: Forecast Spend (Mieruka)
attributes.description: Forecast future spend for the project. Entered in Mieruka by PM.
attributes.notes: Often stale. PMs prefer to maintain forecasts in Excel due to Mieruka performance.

attributes.name: Forecast (Excel)
attributes.description: Detailed financial forecast maintained in Excel by PM.
attributes.notes: Often the real forecast. Version control issues mean different stakeholders may have different versions.

attributes.name: Lead Status
attributes.description: Current pipeline status of a lead opportunity.
attributes.notes: Tracked as Jira issues in a presales board.

attributes.name: Conversion Probability
attributes.description: Estimated probability of winning the opportunity (0-100%).
attributes.notes: Subjective assessment. Used for weighted pipeline calculations.

attributes.name: Pipeline Value
attributes.description: Estimated value of the opportunity if won.
attributes.notes: Based on presales estimate. May change significantly during negotiation.

attributes.name: Change History
attributes.description: Audit trail of project changes (scope, timeline, budget).
attributes.notes: Mieruka tracks some changes but not all. Significant changes often only documented in email.

attributes.name: Resource Change History
attributes.description: History of resource allocation changes on an account.
attributes.notes: Useful for understanding account staffing trends.

attributes.name: Status Report
attributes.description: Weekly/monthly project status report produced by PM.
attributes.notes: Produced manually in Excel/PowerPoint. Time-consuming and often inconsistent format.

attributes.name: Cost Rate
attributes.description: Internal cost rate for the resource (loaded cost including on-costs). Security gap: currently visible to standard users.
attributes.notes: Sourced from TC_FTE table. GDPR and commercial sensitivity risk — rebuild requires field-level security.

attributes.name: Charge-Out Rate
attributes.description: Rate at which resource is billed to projects. Commercial rate used in P&L and margin calculation.
attributes.notes: Stored on FTE record, visible to standard read access — GDPR risk. Rebuild requires secure storage.

attributes.name: FTE Allocation Value (Days)
attributes.description: Quantity of FTE allocation in days for a specific month on a project. Core data for capacity planning.
attributes.notes: Sourced from TC_FTEValues. No capacity ceiling enforcement. Used in Yamazumi capacity view.

attributes.name: FTE Allocation Charge-Out Rate
attributes.description: Charge-out rate applied to this monthly allocation. May vary by project or period.
attributes.notes: Sourced from TC_FTEValues. Used in revenue and margin calculation.

attributes.name: FTE Allocation Cost Rate
attributes.description: Cost rate applied to this monthly allocation. Used in COGS and project cost tracking.
attributes.notes: Sourced from TC_FTEValues.

attributes.name: Budget Version Number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier for budget iterations per project. Budget versioning works reliably today.
attributes.notes: Multiple versions per project allowed. Latest Plan flag identifies current budget.

attributes.name: Budget Latest Plan Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current/active budget version.

attributes.name: Budget Approval Status
attributes.description: Approval status of the budget (Submitted, Approved, Rejected, In Review). Subject to threshold-based routing rules.
attributes.notes: Routing rules exist but execution unreliable.

attributes.name: TBA Status
attributes.description: Lifecycle state of the TBA demand request (created, assigned, fulfilled, closed). Governance is informal today.
attributes.notes: Resource Managers cannot distinguish TBA from TBR without navigating multiple screens.

attributes.name: TBR Request Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this TBA has been escalated to a formal TBR request.

attributes.name: Timesheet Entry Type
attributes.description: Classification of timesheet entry (billable or non-billable code). Non-billable codes include training, bench, admin.
attributes.notes: Determines revenue recognition treatment.

attributes.name: Timesheet Week Ending Date
attributes.description: The Friday date of the timesheet week (Monday-Friday grid).

attributes.name: Revenue Type
attributes.description: Classification of revenue recognition model (T&M, milestone, fixed capacity).
attributes.notes: T&M from approved timesheets; milestone and fixed from PM inputs.

attributes.name: Revenue Currency
attributes.description: Currency of revenue value. Multi-currency with FX rate application.
attributes.notes: FX rates applied via TC_CurrencyFXRate table.

attributes.name: Project Code (Dataverse)
attributes.description: Unique project identifier in Dataverse. Currently ungoverned; flat data model allows dozens of standalone codes.
attributes.notes: No finance gate enforced at project initiation.

attributes.name: Programme Code
attributes.description: Unique programme identifier.

attributes.name: Programme Name
attributes.description: Display name for the programme grouping.

attributes.name: Programme Owner
attributes.description: Executive sponsor or programme director responsible.

attributes.name: Programme Budget (Aggregated)
attributes.description: Total budget aggregated from constituent project budgets.
attributes.notes: Calculated by summing project-level budgets. Drift risk when project budgets update independently.

attributes.name: Person Name
attributes.description: Full name from HR system.

attributes.name: Role
attributes.description: Current job role/title.

attributes.name: Team Assignment
attributes.description: Team the person belongs to.
attributes.notes: Synced to Mieruka but can drift.

attributes.name: Line Manager
attributes.description: Direct line manager.

attributes.name: Day Rate
attributes.description: Standard day rate for costing.
attributes.notes: Used as input for blended rate calculations.

attributes.name: Discipline
attributes.description: Technical discipline (e.g., Engineering, Design, Data).

attributes.name: Team Name
attributes.description: Name of the team unit.

attributes.name: Team Manager
attributes.description: Manager responsible for the team.

attributes.name: Team Headcount
attributes.description: Number of active members.
attributes.notes: Changes with joiners/leavers. Impacts capacity planning.

attributes.name: Discipline Name
attributes.description: Name of the technical discipline.

attributes.name: Resource Manager
attributes.description: Resource manager responsible for this discipline's capacity.

attributes.name: Position Title
attributes.description: Role being recruited for.

attributes.name: Grade
attributes.description: Required seniority level.

attributes.name: Required Start Date
attributes.description: When the resource is needed by.

attributes.name: TBR Status
attributes.description: Current recruitment status (Open/In Progress/Filled/Cancelled).

attributes.name: Domain
attributes.description: Technical domain for the role.

attributes.name: Cost Threshold
attributes.description: Budget amount above which additional approval is required.

attributes.name: GM Threshold
attributes.description: Minimum gross margin percentage before escalation.

attributes.name: Product Type Filter
attributes.description: Which product types this rule applies to.

attributes.name: Approval Notification
attributes.description: Automated notification sent via Teams when timesheet/budget approvals are needed.
attributes.notes: Triggered by Power Automate Get Team ID workflow. Routing depends on team membership lookup.

attributes.name: Compliance Report
attributes.description: Published Power BI report consumed by management for compliance monitoring.
attributes.notes: Read-only consumption from Dataverse. Not a data source — Mieruka feeds Power BI.

attributes.name: Unified Analytics Dataset
attributes.description: Planned consolidated dataset combining Mieruka, Oracle, Jira, and HiBob data.
attributes.notes: Part of Option C architecture. Enables cross-system analytics and continuous reconciliation.

measures.name: Sprint Velocity
measures.description: Average story points completed per sprint over the last 3 sprints
measures.logic: Rolling 3-sprint average of completed story points

measures.name: Sprint Completion Rate
measures.description: Percentage of planned story points actually completed in a sprint
measures.logic: Completed points divided by planned points

measures.name: Backlog Completion Rate
measures.description: Percentage of total backlog that has been completed
measures.logic: Completed stories as fraction of total backlog

measures.name: Budget Variance
measures.description: Difference between approved budget and actual spend
measures.logic: Budget minus actuals. Positive = under budget.

measures.name: Budget Burn Rate
measures.description: Monthly rate of budget consumption
measures.logic: Actuals divided by months elapsed since project start

measures.name: Forecast Accuracy
measures.description: How close the forecast was to actual spend
measures.logic: Absolute difference between forecast and actuals as percentage of actuals

measures.name: Resource Utilization
measures.description: Ratio of allocated/billed time to available time
measures.logic: Approved hours divided by available capacity

measures.name: Billable Days
measures.description: Total approved billable days for a project/resource
measures.logic: Sum of approved timesheet days

measures.name: Total People Cost
measures.description: Total cost of resources allocated to a project
measures.logic: Sum of (blended rate × allocated days) for each resource

measures.name: Gross Margin
measures.description: Project profitability as percentage of revenue
measures.logic: Revenue minus total cost, divided by revenue

measures.name: Revenue per Project
measures.description: Total recognized revenue for a project
measures.logic: Oracle revenue actuals for the project code

measures.name: Weighted Pipeline Value
measures.description: Total pipeline value weighted by conversion probability
measures.logic: Sum of (pipeline value × probability) for all active leads

measures.name: Lead Conversion Rate
measures.description: Percentage of leads that convert to active projects
measures.logic: Won leads divided by total qualified leads

measures.name: Resource Capacity
measures.description: Available capacity after accounting for leave and existing allocations
measures.logic: Total availability minus time-off minus current allocation

measures.name: Timesheet Approval Rate
measures.description: Percentage of submitted hours that are approved
measures.logic: Approved hours divided by submitted hours

measures.name: Forecast vs Budget
measures.description: How the current forecast compares to original budget
measures.logic: Forecast as percentage of budget

measures.name: Total Allocated FTE per Team
measures.description: Sum of resource allocations across all team members for a given period. Critical for identifying over-allocation.
measures.logic: Sum of allocation percentages grouped by team and month
measures.formula: SUM(attr_fte_value_days / working_days_in_month) GROUP BY team, month

measures.name: Project Total Labor Cost
measures.description: Sum of all resource costs allocated to a project. Drives P&L view.
measures.logic: Sum of (cost rate × allocation days) for all resources

measures.name: Billable Hours per Project
measures.description: Total approved hours excluding non-billable time codes. Drives invoice line generation.
measures.logic: Sum of approved hours where entry type is billable

measures.name: Monthly Revenue by Billing Model
measures.description: Revenue recognized by billing model: T&M from timesheet hours, milestone from PM status, fixed capacity from schedule.
measures.logic: T&M: billable hours × charge-out rate; Milestone: amount where completed; Fixed: fixed fee / months
measures.formula: CASE attr_revenue_type WHEN 'T&M' THEN hours × rate WHEN 'Milestone' THEN amount WHEN 'Fixed' THEN fee / months END

measures.name: Resource Over-Allocation
measures.description: Count of resources allocated above 100% capacity. Identifies blind allocation and double-booking.
measures.logic: Count where total monthly allocation exceeds capacity

measures.name: Timesheet Approval Cycle Time
measures.description: Days from timesheet submission to final approval. Currently high due to Finance blanket approval.
measures.logic: Average days between submission and approval

measures.name: Programme Total Budget
measures.description: Aggregated budget across all projects in a programme.
measures.logic: Sum of approved project budgets grouped by programme

measures.name: Team Capacity
measures.description: Available capacity per team based on headcount and allocation.
measures.logic: Team headcount multiplied by working days minus allocated days

measures.name: TBR Fill Rate
measures.description: Percentage of TBR positions filled within target timeframe.
measures.logic: Filled TBRs divided by total TBRs as a percentage

measures.name: Person Cost Rate
measures.description: Individual cost rate used for project costing.
measures.logic: Day rate multiplied by allocation percentage

metrics.name: Project Delivery Performance
metrics.description: Composite indicator of how well projects are being delivered against sprint commitments
metrics.business_question: Are we delivering what we committed to in sprints?

metrics.name: Resource Utilization Rate
metrics.description: How effectively are consulting resources being utilized across projects
metrics.business_question: Are our people fully utilized, or do we have idle capacity?

metrics.name: Budget Adherence
metrics.description: How well projects are tracking against their approved budgets
metrics.business_question: Are we spending within approved budgets?

metrics.name: Forecast Accuracy
metrics.description: How accurate are financial forecasts compared to actual outcomes
metrics.business_question: Can we trust our forecasts for planning decisions?

metrics.name: Revenue & Gross Margin
metrics.description: Revenue generation and profitability at project and portfolio level
metrics.business_question: Are we profitable? What's our margin per project?

metrics.name: Pipeline Health
metrics.description: Health and conversion rate of the presales pipeline
metrics.business_question: Do we have enough pipeline to sustain future revenue?

metrics.name: Timesheet Compliance
metrics.description: How reliably are timesheets being submitted and approved on time
metrics.business_question: Are timesheets being submitted and approved promptly?

metrics.name: Resource Over-Allocation Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of resources allocated above 100% capacity.
metrics.business_question: Which resources are over-allocated and creating delivery risk?

metrics.name: Project Code Governance Score
metrics.description: Count and proliferation rate of project codes. Flat data model allows dozens of standalone codes.
metrics.business_question: How ungovernable is our project code structure?

metrics.name: 3+9 Forecast Accuracy
metrics.description: Accuracy of 3-month detailed + 9-month planning forecast against actuals. Cannot be measured natively today.
metrics.business_question: How accurately are we forecasting demand 3 and 9 months out?

metrics.name: Margin by Project and Programme
metrics.description: Project and programme-level gross margin. Data exists but aggregation layer does not.
metrics.business_question: What is our margin profile by project and programme?

metrics.name: Timesheet Approval Cycle Time
metrics.description: Days from timesheet submission to final approval.
metrics.business_question: How long does timesheet approval take and what drives delays?

processes.name: Lead to Project Pipeline
processes.description: End-to-end process from opportunity identification through to project kickoff

steps.name: Capture Lead / Opportunity
steps.description: BD or account manager identifies a new opportunity and creates a lead in Jira presales board

steps.name: Create Presales Estimate
steps.description: Solution architect and presales create effort estimate, demand by role, and gross margin estimate in Excel

steps.name: Qualify & Assess Probability
steps.description: BD assesses conversion probability and updates pipeline value based on client engagement

steps.name: Create & Sign SOW
steps.description: PM drafts SOW using presales estimate, gets client sign-off, stores in SharePoint

steps.name: Set Up Project in Systems
steps.description: Finance creates Oracle project code, PM creates Mieruka project, Jira board is set up

steps.name: Allocate Initial Resources
steps.description: RM allocates resources based on demand by role. Must use both Mieruka (official) and Excel (actual granular allocation)

processes.name: Project Delivery Cycle
processes.description: Ongoing sprint-based delivery, status reporting, and project monitoring

steps.name: Sprint Planning
steps.description: Scrum master and team plan sprint backlog, set planned story points

steps.name: Execute Sprint Work
steps.description: Development team completes stories, updates Jira, logs time

steps.name: Submit Timesheets
steps.description: Resources submit weekly timesheets in Mieruka against project codes

steps.name: Approve Timesheets
steps.description: PM reviews and approves submitted timesheets

steps.name: Update RAG Status
steps.description: PM updates project RAG status in Mieruka based on sprint results and risks

steps.name: Produce Status Report
steps.description: PM manually compiles status report from Jira, Mieruka, and Excel data

steps.name: Update Financial Forecast
steps.description: PM updates spending forecast based on current burn rate and remaining scope

processes.name: Month-End Financial Reporting
processes.description: Monthly financial close, variance analysis, and portfolio reporting

steps.name: Close Timesheet Period
steps.description: Ensure all timesheets submitted and approved for the period

steps.name: Post Actuals to Oracle
steps.description: Finance posts approved timesheets and costs to Oracle GL

steps.name: Budget Variance Analysis
steps.description: Finance compares actuals to budget and forecast, identifies variances

steps.name: Compile Portfolio Report
steps.description: PMO compiles portfolio-level report for leadership with project RAGs, financials, and risks

processes.name: Resource Allocation & Capacity Planning
processes.description: Ongoing process of matching resource capacity to project demand

steps.name: Review Resource Capacity
steps.description: RM checks availability across all resources, accounting for leave and current allocations

steps.name: Match Demand to Capacity
steps.description: RM cross-references project demand (from pipeline and active projects) with available capacity

steps.name: Update Resource Allocations
steps.description: RM updates allocations in both Mieruka (one project limit) and Excel (actual split)

steps.name: Review Resource Costs
steps.description: Finance reviews blended rates and people costs, updates as needed for new hires or rate changes

processes.name: TBA → TBR Resource Demand Lifecycle
processes.description: Process for managing resource demand from initial unnamed requirement (TBA) through to recruitment trigger (TBR) and named resource assignment

steps.name: Create TBA Demand Line
steps.description: PM creates TBA demand line on project specifying role, skill level, location, and FTE type.

steps.name: Resource Manager Reviews TBA
steps.description: RM reviews TBA demand against team capacity. Currently no enforcement — PMs can commit resources without RM sign-off.

steps.name: Match to Named Resource or Escalate to TBR
steps.description: RM either assigns a named resource from available capacity or escalates TBA to TBR (recruitment trigger).

steps.name: Process TBR Recruitment Request
steps.description: If escalated: RM creates formal recruitment request with position, grade, skills. Triggers approval path and IT onboarding.

steps.name: Assign Named Resource to Project
steps.description: Create FTE allocation record linking resource to project. Update both Mieruka and Excel.

processes.name: Budget Version Approval
processes.description: Process for submitting, reviewing, and approving project budget versions using threshold-based routing rules. Currently unreliable.

steps.name: Create Budget Version
steps.description: PM creates new budget version with revenue schedule, cost breakdown, and FTE allocations. Multi-currency.

steps.name: Submit Budget for Approval
steps.description: PM submits budget. System should match against approval rules but routing is currently unreliable.

steps.name: Threshold-Based Approval Routing
steps.description: System evaluates budget against cost, GM, and revenue thresholds. Sends daily digest emails. Currently broken.

steps.name: Approver Reviews Budget
steps.description: Each approver reviews and approves/rejects. Sequential notification. No FYI-only support today.

steps.name: Set Latest Plan Flag & Activate
steps.description: Once approved, budget version gets Latest Plan flag. Previous version loses it.
